modifications: Compacted independently named Z-Anatomy source triangles into two Draco GLBs without changing source geometry, IDs, materials, side or coordinate frame. Added only current-body head-region and opt-in search display metadata.

coordinates.sourceToApp: Apply complete FBX node world transform, then divide positions by 100. This model is not spatially registered to BodyParts3D 4.0.

limitations: The University of Dundee vestibule and cochlea surfaces (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) are excluded from this commercial distribution; no inner-ear surface is included.
No separate whole auricle, external acoustic meatus, semicircular canals, oval window or complete middle-ear cavity source surface is included.
Auditory tube ends remain 7.463 mm from the current source nasopharynx; no terminal connection or bridge is inferred.

subset.modifications: Authored triangle payloads, source material attributes and names, source IDs, per-mesh licenses, and Z frame retained. Added only current-body head-region and explicit search-presentation metadata.
subset.scope: Ten original bilateral named tympanic, ossicular and auditory-tube surfaces; no inner ear, inferred middle-ear cavity, external canal, semicircular canals, or bridge across source gaps.
subset.licenseBoundary: Ten external/middle surfaces CC BY-SA 4.0. Non-commercial inner-ear surfaces removed.
